svg.aria-label: Measure both paths from one consumer host: PrivateLink DNS versus relay private IP over TGW
svg.title: Measure — same host, two targets
svg.desc: On the consumer subscriber EC2, open two concurrent TCP 9000 streams: left path uses the PrivateLink interface endpoint DNS; right path uses the provider relay private IP through Transit Gateway and Network Firewall. Watch both with tmux, nc, and pv.
